# awscc_translate_parallel_data (Resource)

A parallel data resource in Amazon Translate used to customize machine translation output.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A custom name for the parallel data resource. Must be unique in the account and region.
- `parallel_data_config` (Attributes) Specifies the format and S3 location of the parallel data input file. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--parallel_data_config))

### Optional

- `description` (String) A custom description for the parallel data resource.
- `encryption_key` (Attributes) The encryption key used to encrypt this object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--encryption_key))
- `tags` (Attributes List) Tags associated with the parallel data resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the parallel data resource.
- `created_at` (String) The time at which the parallel data resource was created.
- `failed_record_count` (Number) The number of records unsuccessfully imported.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `imported_data_size` (Number) The number of UTF-8 characters imported from the parallel data input file.
- `imported_record_count` (Number) The number of records successfully imported.
- `last_updated_at` (String) The time at which the parallel data resource was last updated.
- `skipped_record_count` (Number) The number of items skipped during import.
- `source_language_code` (String) The source language of the translations in the parallel data file.
- `status` (String) The status of the parallel data resource.
- `target_language_codes` (List of String) The language codes for the target languages available in the parallel data file.

<a id="nestedatt--parallel_data_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `parallel_data_config`

Required:

- `format` (String) The format of the parallel data input file.
- `s3_uri` (String) The URI of the Amazon S3 folder that contains the parallel data input file.


<a id="nestedatt--encryption_key"></a>
### Nested Schema for `encryption_key`

Optional:

- `id` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the encryption key.
- `type` (String) The type of encryption key.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_translate_parallel_data.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the parallel data resource

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_translate_parallel_data.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_translate_parallel_data.example "arn"
```
